title: rosa canina subsp. spuria
intro: Rosa canina subsp. spuria, commonly known as the wild rose or prickly rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant, a deciduous shrub native to Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Rosa canina subsp. spuria include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation and pain, and supporting cardiovascular health, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine.
